newsitem.title: UK: Easier gallstone operation good alternative - study.
newsitem.headline: Easier gallstone operation good alternative - study.

text.p: A new method for removing gallstones could be a valuable and less traumatic alternative to current treatment, Dutch doctors reported on Friday.
They said a trial showed a tiny balloon could be used to open the bile-duct to remove gallstones, rather than splitting open the sphincter that controls the opening of the duct.
Dr Jacques Bergman and colleagues at the University of Amsterdam described the new method, endoscopic balloon dilation, in a letter to the Lancet medical journal.

They said tests on 200 patients showed it worked just as well as endoscopic sphincterotomy (splitting the sphincter) with slightly fewer side-effects -- although in cases of bigger stones the older method may work better.
